brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.
Two bases a cell apart, with a drawer that fills the gap between them.
A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.
A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
Two bases side by side joined with side connectors, each with a bin.
A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell.
A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.
One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
